name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Greeting Card Keeper With Hanging Piece
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material: 
    – Made from premium 3mm natural wood, laser-cut for smooth edges and high durability.
    Includes a custom hanging wooden piece that can be personalized based on your design (minimum size 3 cm).
    – Metal loose-leaf binder rings and jute twine rope are included for easy assembly and hanging.

 

  • Sizes and Dimensions: 
    - The product comes in two size options (Front & Back Cover: WxH):
    6 × 8 inches ~ 15.24 × 20.32 cm
    8 × 8 inches ~ 20.32 × 20.32 cm
    -  Binder Rings: 1.77 in (4.5 cm) diameter
    -  Custom hanging piece: Minimum 3 cm, shape customizable.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Double-sided UV printing allows for fully personalized artwork, text, or photos.
    - Ensures sharp, vibrant, fade-resistant colors on both sides of the wooden covers.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a greeting card keeper, helping you store and display meaningful cards, notes, or photos.
    - Includes a hanging wooden piece on the front cover—ideal for adding a personal touch such as initials, dates, symbols, or themed icons.
    - Loose-leaf binder rings make it easy to add, remove, or reorganize cards. Perfect as:
                     +) A keepsake memory holder
                     +) A small scrapbook
                     +) A decorative display piece for shelves, desks, or coffee tables

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion: 
    - This customizable wooden greeting card keeper makes a thoughtful and heartfelt gift for: Birthdays, Anniversaries, Weddings, Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day / Father’s Day, Christmas, Any special milestone or celebration.
    - Its personalized design and sentimental functionality make it suitable for everyone—family, friends, lovers, teachers, co-workers, and more.

  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Greeting Card Keeper With Hanging Piece

 

PRODUCTION

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
